author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
We have some exciting news to share: we’re launching our own China tours!
If you’ve ever wanted to experience China beyond the guidebooks, come travel with us:
littlechineseeverywhere.com/tours

In this video, we explore the breathtaking karst landscapes of the Enshi region in Hubei Province, China. This incredible geological formation is part of one of the world’s largest karst regions, stretching from central China all the way to the famous Ha Long Bay in northern Vietnam.
Over millions of years, underground rivers and water erosion slowly carved through the limestone, creating a dramatic landscape filled with enormous sinkholes, caves, and hidden underground worlds.
Inside some of these sinkholes, researchers have discovered unique ecosystems where species believed to be extinct elsewhere have survived, protected by the isolated environment and special microclimate found deep within these natural formations.
